title: Official notices to parents
description: Circulars are issued by the school office and sent home with students. They are published here so that a misplaced copy is never a problem.
note: Circulars for the current session are added as they are issued. For a circular older than one session, please contact the school office on +91 96577 66740.

items.title: Commencement of the 2026–27 academic session
items.summary: Reopening dates by section, revised timings for Pre-Primary, Primary, High School and Junior College, and the uniform requirement for the first week.

items.title: Book sets and stationery for the new session
items.summary: Grade-wise book set details, the approximate cost of each set, and the collection schedule at the school office.

items.title: Identity cards and campus safety procedure
items.summary: Issue of student identity cards, the authorised-person procedure for collection, and a reminder of the CCTV and gate protocol.

items.title: Plantation drive — participation and rota
items.summary: Arrangements for the annual plantation drive, the class watering rota for the session, and what students should bring.

items.title: Independence Day — assembly points and timings
items.summary: Section-wise assembly points, reporting time, uniform requirement and arrangements for parents attending the ceremony.

items.title: First term assessment schedule
items.summary: The first term unit test and terminal examination timetable, along with the syllabus portion for each subject.
